data.name: Trap Sense
data.description: At 3rd level, a sandman gains a +%1 bonus on Reflex saves against traps and a +%1 dodge bonus to AC against traps. These bonuses increase by +1 every three levels after 3rd. This ability replaces inspire competence.|BardLVL/3
